mapper.sql: SELECT 'person' AS record_type, pi.kind, pi.normalized_value, pi.person_id AS record_id, p.name AS record_name, ic.rebuilt_at FROM identity_collision ic JOIN person_identity pi ON pi.workspace_id = ic.workspace_id AND pi.id = ic.person_identity_id JOIN person p ON p.workspace_id = pi.workspace_id AND p.id = pi.person_id WHERE ic.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ic.person_identity_id IS NOT NULL AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND p.provision_ceased_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'company' AS record_type, ci.kind, ci.normalized_value, ci.company_id AS record_id, c.name AS record_name, ic.rebuilt_at FROM identity_collision ic JOIN company_identity ci ON ci.workspace_id = ic.workspace_id AND ci.id = ic.company_identity_id JOIN company c ON c.workspace_id = ci.workspace_id AND c.id = ci.company_id WHERE ic.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND ic.company_identity_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO identity_collision (workspace_id, person_identity_id, rebuilt_at) SELECT collision.workspace_id, collision.identity_id, #{rebuiltAt} FROM ( SELECT pi.workspace_id, pi.id AS identity_id, COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY pi.workspace_id, pi.kind, pi.normalized_value ) AS collision_size FROM person_identity pi JOIN person p ON p.workspace_id = pi.workspace_id AND p.id = pi.person_id WHERE pi.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND p.provision_ceased_at IS NULL ) collision WHERE collision.collision_size >= 2 ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rebuilt_at = #{rebuiltAt}
